text: おまえも　すごいが　おれも　すごいだろ？

structure.jp: おまえも　すごいが
おれも　すごいだろ？

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が after a finished statement joins it to the next one and means 'but'. すごいが = 'amazing, but'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is a clipped, rough form of だろう, which asks the listener to agree. すごいだろ = 'amazing, right?'.
